meta.source: U.S. Census Bureau, International Trade API (HS4, monthly, by country)

hs_codes.8541: Discrete semiconductors (diodes, transistors, LEDs, solar cells)

events.description: 25% additional tariff on about $34B of Chinese imports (Section 301, List 1)
events.notes: Date confirmed in the 2024 Federal Register notice; check the List 1 annex for which semiconductor HTS lines it covered

events.description: 25% additional tariff on about $16B of Chinese imports across 279 HTS codes, mainly electronics and chemicals (Section 301, List 2)
events.notes: Semiconductor HTS coverage not yet confirmed against the official USTR annex

events.description: CHIPS and Science Act signed into law, providing about $52.7B for U.S. semiconductor manufacturing, research and workforce
events.notes: Signing date per Congress.gov (Public Law 117-167). Most manufacturing awards came in 2024, so effects on equipment imports may lag the signing

events.description: Commerce (BIS) controls on advanced computing chips and semiconductor manufacturing items to China
BIS expands semiconductor manufacturing equipment and advanced computing controls, including more destinations
events.notes: Three rules; published in the Federal Register 2023-10-19

events.description: Section 301 tariff on Chinese semiconductors (HS 8541/8542) rises to 50%; solar wafers and polysilicon also rise to 50%
events.notes: Wafer and polysilicon increase confirmed in USTR release of 2024-12-11

events.description: Commerce opens a Section 232 national security investigation into semiconductor imports (announced in the Federal Register 2025-04-16)
events.notes: Certain semiconductors were excluded from reciprocal tariffs effective 2025-04-05
